title: Ghost and Debt
author: Lior Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Joubert, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
